prompts: Edit this rejected wordmark into a refined modern creator identity, not an embroidered sports patch. Text exactly "AdmiraL 8", anchor replaces i. KEEP the large anchor's silhouette: round upper eye, crossbar, straight stem, angular U bottom with flat base and both flukes pointing upward. Keep anchor slightly overlapping m and r with negative-space separation. REPLACE all varsity slab-serif letterforms with heavy custom contemporary SANS SERIF lettering, upright, clean flat terminals, squared shoulders with minimal corner chamfers, carefully balanced optical spacing. Absolutely NO serifs, varsity notches, football jersey numerals, outlines, borders, shadows, bevels, texture, shine, gradient or badge. Do not use bubbly rounded lettering or racing italics. The numeral 8 must belong to the same restrained heavy sans-serif family. All letters and 8 solid pale cool ivory, ONLY anchor solid muted brass gold. Nautical Kunkka mood through the anchor and restrained brass, not a costume or sports emblem. Flat crisp two-color vector-like silhouette on solid black. One centered wide wordmark only, no username, no additional decoration. Strong memorable but understated, readable when small.

Targeted typography correction of this logo. Keep exact text AdmiraL 8, palette, layout and gold anchor absolutely unchanged. Only edit letters d m r a: their upper shoulders are still very ROUND. Replace these curved domed shoulders with long straight horizontal tops and small diagonal 45-degree corner chamfers. Use squared industrial modern sans lettering, NOT varsity, NOT slab serif. Keep plain flat terminals, no serifs, no outlines. The m especially needs flat horizontal shoulders, not two rounded humps. Match the angular construction of the existing 8 while keeping mixed-case readability. Preserve heavy weight, clean black negative spaces, ivory letters, gold anchor with upturned flukes, solid black background. No shadows, texture, borders or decoration.
